# v3 Multimodal LLM Experiment Results

Protocol: LLaVA-style VLM (ViT-B/16 vision + MLP projector + Qwen2-0.5B with LoRA). Train on COCO2017 train2017; model selection on a 2,500-image val split; COCO2017 fixed split (not Karpathy). All runs are resumable, seed-controlled, and recorded in config.json/metrics.jsonl.

## Interpretation

- Vision initialization ranks consistently CLIP > MAE > random on BLEU/METEOR/ROUGE-L/SPICE across all three seeds. MAE raises METEOR by +0.066 over random; CLIP raises it a further +0.028 over MAE.
- CIDEr is ~0 across every condition, so it cannot rank models; the generative style (repetition) is initialization-independent.
- Hallucination (CHAIR_s) also ranks CLIP (0.244) < MAE (0.349) < random (0.668): better visual features reduce object hallucination in generated captions.
